subject: Invoice discrepancy this month
body: My invoice this month shows an extra charge of $50 that I do not recognize. Please review my billing statement and refund the incorrect amount.

subject: Unable to update credit card
body: I am trying to update my credit card details on the payment page but it keeps failing. Can you help me fix my billing information?

subject: Refund not received yet
body: I cancelled my subscription two weeks ago and was promised a refund but I still have not received the money in my account.

subject: Double charged for subscription
body: I was charged twice for my monthly plan this billing cycle. Please refund the duplicate charge as soon as possible.

subject: Question about invoice total
body: Why is my invoice total higher than last month? I did not upgrade my plan so I am confused about the extra fees.

subject: Payment failed error
body: My payment failed during checkout even though my card has sufficient funds. Please check my billing account and let me know what went wrong.

subject: Need a copy of past receipts
body: Can you send me copies of my receipts from the last three months for my accounting records?

subject: Subscription auto-renewed unexpectedly
body: My subscription auto renewed and I was charged before I could cancel. I would like a refund for this billing cycle.

subject: Wrong plan billed
body: I was billed for the premium plan but I signed up for the basic plan. Please correct my invoice and adjust the charge.

subject: Tax invoice request
body: I need a GST tax invoice for my last payment for company reimbursement purposes.

subject: App crashes on login
body: Every time I try to log in to the mobile app it crashes immediately. I have reinstalled it twice but the issue persists.

subject: Server is down
body: Our production server has been down for the last hour and none of our services are responding. This is urgent.

subject: Error 500 on checkout page
body: I keep getting a 500 internal server error when I try to check out on the website. Please fix this bug.

subject: Cannot connect to database
body: The application throws a database connection timeout error whenever I try to load the dashboard.

subject: API returning wrong data
body: The API endpoint for user data is returning null values for fields that should have data. Something seems broken.

subject: Website not loading
body: The website has been extremely slow and sometimes does not load at all for the past two days.

subject: Password reset link not working
body: I clicked the password reset link in my email but it says the link has expired even though I just requested it.

subject: Feature not saving changes
body: Whenever I edit my profile settings and click save the changes do not persist and revert back.

subject: Mobile app not syncing
body: My data on the mobile app is not syncing with the web version and I am losing my recent edits.

subject: Integration broken after update
body: After the latest software update our third party integration stopped working and is throwing connection errors.

subject: Request for leave approval
body: I would like to request annual leave from next Monday to Friday. Please let me know if this is approved.

subject: Question about health insurance
body: Can someone from HR explain the details of our new health insurance policy and how to add a dependent?

subject: Payroll discrepancy this month
body: My salary this month seems lower than usual and I think there might be an error in my payroll calculation.

subject: Onboarding documents needed
body: I am a new employee starting next week and I have not yet received my onboarding paperwork and offer letter.

subject: Request for employment verification letter
body: I need an employment verification letter from HR for a loan application. Could you please issue one?

subject: Maternity leave policy question
body: Could you share the details of the company's maternity leave policy and how many weeks are covered?

subject: Complaint about workplace conduct
body: I want to file a formal complaint regarding a coworker's behavior in our department and request HR to look into it.

subject: Update my bank details for salary
body: I recently changed banks and need to update my bank account details for salary deposits with HR.

subject: Performance review schedule
body: When is my next performance review scheduled and who will be conducting it this cycle?

subject: Resignation letter submission
body: I would like to formally submit my resignation letter with a two week notice period effective today.

subject: General inquiry about office hours
body: What are the current office working hours and is the office open on public holidays?

subject: Question about company policy
body: I have a general question about the company's remote work policy and whether it has changed recently.

subject: Feedback on your service
body: I just wanted to share some general feedback about my overall experience using your platform this year.

subject: Request for product brochure
body: Could you send me a general brochure with information about all your available products and services?

subject: How do I contact support
body: I am not sure who to reach out to for my issue. Can you point me to the right department or contact?

subject: Suggestion for new feature
body: I have an idea for a new feature that I think would improve the product. Where can I submit suggestions?

subject: Partnership opportunity inquiry
body: We are interested in exploring a potential partnership with your company and would like more information.

subject: Event invitation question
body: I received an invitation to your upcoming webinar and wanted to confirm the date and time of the event.

subject: Media inquiry about company
body: I am a journalist writing an article about your company and would like to schedule an interview.

subject: General thank you note
body: I just wanted to say thank you for the great support I have received over the past few months.
